source_evidence: In this model, the security carries the same legal rights – voting, dividends, ownership – as a traditional share of the same class.
question: Misconception: An issuer-sponsored tokenized security always gives its holder different rights from a traditional share.
answer: Correction: In the issuer-sponsored model, the security carries the same legal rights as a traditional share of the same class, including voting, dividends, and ownership. However, the tokenized security could be a different class from shares issued in traditional form.
